item.title: NIF Dispute, Carifta Audit, Politician Probe
item.ns0:title: NIF Dispute, Carifta Audit, Politician Probe
item.description:
Tonight on Our News, Prime Minister Philip Davis fires back against opposition claims of wrongdoing surrounding the National Investment Fund, dismissing legal threats and labeling the controversy political antics. Tensions also rise on the sports front as Minister Mario Bowleg defends the handling of the 2023 Carifta Games following a Public Accounts Committee report pointing to major financial oversight failures. Meanwhile, a 24-year-old man faces court after allegedly exposing himself to students at a local primary school, and police offer an update on the lingering mystery surrounding "Politician Number One." Plus, we examine opposition reactions to industrial expansion in Grand Bahama, the truth behind social media rumors of a Cat Island plane crash, and your complete sports and weather forecast.
